name: CSS Optimization Pipeline

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'src/css/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  process-css:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Minify CSS (src/css/ -> src/css/clean/)
        run: |
          mkdir -p src/css/clean
          npm install -g clean-css-cli
          if [ -d "src/css" ]; then
            for file in src/css/*.css; do
              [ -e "$file" ] || continue
              filename=$(basename "$file")
              cleancss -o "src/css/clean/$filename" "$file"
            done
          fi

      - name: Brotli Compress CSS (src/css/clean/ -> web/css/)
        uses: stefh/ghaction-CompressFiles@v2
        with:
          path: './src/css/clean'
          extensions: '.css'
          tools: 'brotli'

      - name: Move Compressed Files & Delete Clean Folder
        run: |
          mkdir -p web/css
          if [ -d "src/css/clean" ]; then
            cp src/css/clean/*.br web/css/ 2>/dev/null || true
            rm -rf src/css/clean
          fi

      - name: Commit and Push CSS Changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@://github.com"
          git add web/css/
          git rm -r --cached src/css/clean/ 2>/dev/null || true
          if ! git diff --staged --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: optimize and compress css assets [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi
